eventMetadata.context_description: Toronto Tempo (11-28) visit the Phoenix Mercury (13-26) on August 29 amid a late-season matchup between two Eastern Conference teams eliminated from playoff contention. The Tempo enter on a back-to-back after a 73-93 road loss to the Aces, with multiple starters sidelined including Marina Mabrey (hip), Julie Allemand (head), Nyara Sabally (calf), and Maria Conde. Phoenix lists Kahleah Copper as questionable with an ankle issue while Marta Suarez remains out with a concussion. Earlier this season the Mercury prevailed 89-80 in Toronto despite their own absences. Home-court rest and roster depth give Phoenix the clearer edge in implied probability, though both clubs’ depleted lineups and recent form underscore the matchup’s unpredictability.
